content: bug-3 RESOLVED 2026-10-09: niri renders in QEMU (86/86 zero skips, run 2026-10-09T18-21-04Z). Chain: Nix QEMU 11.1.1 full via dynamic /usr/local/bin wrappers (libvirt/virt-manager compatible) + virtio-vga-gl venus + egl-headless,gl=on + kernel 7.0 HWE + guest mesa 26.2.4 @edge (virgl restored) = output Virtual-1, wayvnc :5900, real PNG. Installer: enableEdgeRepos+extraPackagesEdge confined feature edgerepos.go (3-step: add repos->install->comment; apk v3 tagged-repo masking kills mid-install mixing). Console keymap busybox-loadkmap-dinit + KEYMAP from variables. Harness: QEMU gates removed (checks real everywhere), keymap regex [{+}] fixed, screenshot count-based. Next: real-hw validation.

less ships as aports package less-dummy (POSIX-sh wrapper eating less flags, dumps via bat --paging=never, provides=less=999+replaces=less) instead of runtime mkpkg symlink less->bat — bat execs hardcoded pager 'less -R -F -K --no-init' on TTY (ignores $PAGER), symlink made bat re-exec itself, clap 'unexpected argument -R' broke fish history/git log/man

2026-10-09 session: less shim round. Confirmed fish history clap bug live via debug_run (bat TTY -> hardcoded less -R -F -K --no-init -> symlink less->bat = bat re-exec, clap error). Fix: aports less-dummy 999.0.0-r2 (f8dcee5, CI green after build.yml container switch to public.ecr.aws docker mirror — Docker Hub rate limit blocked 3 runs). Installer: less-dummy in standardPackages, dummyPackages:{}. Harness: less_dummy falsifiable (apk info -e less-dummy && ! test -L /usr/bin/less && printf 'shim-test' | less -R), old symlink post-processing deleted. Builds green. NEXT: niri fixture harness run; optional BAT_PAGER=cat; future moar/ov pager.
